FINAL AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT COMPLETION — EXECUTE NOW

OWNER DIRECTIVE

We are now in the final stage.

The infrastructure is already substantially complete:

- GitHub repository is IVX-owned
- GitHub Actions is green
- Render API is live
- Render worker is live
- GitHub SHA matches Render SHA
- /health returns HTTP 200
- /version returns the live SHA
- Public chat returns HTTP 200
- Worker auth gate correctly returns HTTP 401 when unauthenticated

The remaining task is to complete one real owner-approved autonomous deployment end to end.

Do not return another explanation.
Do not return another architecture report.
Do not stop at a checkpoint.

Complete:

OWNER LOGIN
→ AUTHORIZE
→ WORKER CONSUME
→ CI
→ BUILD
→ DEPLOY
→ VERIFY
→ PROOF
→ REPLAY REJECTION

==================================================
1. COMPLETE THE OWNER AUTHORIZATION UI
==================================================

Add or finalize this owner-only control inside IVX:

AUTHORIZE AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT

Location:

- Owner Dashboard
or
- Admin Hub
or
- IVX IA Owner Settings

The control must only be visible to the registered IVX owner.

It must use the current Supabase session automatically:

supabase.auth.getSession()

If the session is expired:

1. Call supabase.auth.refreshSession()
2. Retry once
3. If refresh fails, require normal owner login
4. Do not create an infinite retry loop

Do not ask the owner to copy or paste any token into Rork chat.

==================================================
2. AUTHORIZE ONE EXACT DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

The owner must approve:

- Repository: ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
- Branch: main
- Exact GitHub HEAD SHA
- Worker: ivx-senior-dev-01
- Action: production-deploy
- Environment: production
- Expiration: 10 minutes
- Single use: required

Call:

POST /api/ivx/senior-developer/generate-worker-access

Header:

Authorization: Bearer <current live Supabase session.access_token>

The backend must:

- Validate the Supabase JWT
- Confirm the user is the registered IVX owner
- Generate a cryptographically secure short-lived token
- Store only the SHA-256 hash
- Never log the raw token
- Never persist the raw token
- Bind it to exact action
- Bind it to exact commit SHA
- Bind it to exact worker ID
- Expire automatically
- Write issuance to the proof ledger

Expected:

- Valid owner: HTTP 201
- Missing session: HTTP 401
- Invalid/expired session: HTTP 401
- Non-owner: HTTP 403

==================================================
3. SECURELY HAND OFF TO THE WORKER
==================================================

The worker must present:

- Existing HMAC worker identity
- Short-lived worker authorization
- Exact requested action
- Exact commit SHA
- Worker ID
- Timestamp
- Nonce
- Request ID

The backend must verify:

- HMAC identity valid
- Token hash matches
- Token unused
- Token unexpired
- Token not revoked
- Action exact match
- Commit exact match
- Worker exact match
- Nonce unused
- Timestamp valid

Then atomically mark the token as used.

==================================================
4. CREATE THE AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT JOB
==================================================

Create one real job with these states:

- approval_created
- authorization_issued
- job_queued
- worker_authenticated
- token_consumed
- checkout_started
- tests_started
- tests_passed
- build_started
- build_passed
- deployment_started
- deployment_live
- health_verified
- version_verified
- proof_written
- job_completed

Required fields:

- Job ID
- Authorization ID
- Worker ID
- Repository
- Branch
- Approved SHA
- Executed SHA
- Created at
- Started at
- Completed at
- Final result
- Proof ledger ID

==================================================
5. RUN THE FULL CI GATE
==================================================

Run the real GitHub Actions workflow on the approved SHA.

Required checks:

- Backend tests
- Android release consistency
- Type checks
- Integration tests
- Security scan
- Secret scan
- Dependency audit
- Rork-independence guard
- Backend build
- Worker build
- Website build
- APK release validation if configured

Do not deploy if any required check fails.

Return:

- Workflow run ID
- Commit SHA
- Every job status
- Start time
- End time
- Final workflow result

==================================================
6. DEPLOY THE EXACT APPROVED SHA
==================================================

Deploy to the existing services only:

API:
ivx-holdings-platform

Worker:
ivx-senior-dev-01

Website:
existing IVX production website service

Do not:

- create a new repository
- create a new Render service
- deploy an older commit
- substitute another SHA
- bypass CI
- bypass owner authorization

Return:

- GitHub HEAD SHA
- Approved SHA
- API deployment ID
- Worker deployment ID
- Website deployment ID
- API live SHA
- Worker live SHA
- Website live version
- Deployment timestamps

All applicable SHAs must match.

==================================================
7. VERIFY LIVE PRODUCTION
==================================================

Run live checks:

WEBSITE
- https://ivxholding.com
- /robots.txt
- /sitemap.xml

API
- /health
- /version

CHAT
- normal public chat
- protected deployment request

OWNER
- owner route without auth
- owner route with valid owner session

WORKER
- status
- heartbeat
- queue depth
- latest job

Expected:

- Website HTTP 200
- robots.txt HTTP 200
- sitemap.xml HTTP 200
- /health HTTP 200
- /version HTTP 200
- /version SHA matches GitHub HEAD
- Public chat HTTP 200
- Unauthorized deploy request safely blocked
- Missing owner auth returns HTTP 401
- Valid owner authorization succeeds
- Worker heartbeat healthy
- Job status completed

==================================================
8. PROVE REPLAY REJECTION
==================================================

After the first successful consumption:

- Attempt to reuse the same worker authorization
- Reject the second attempt
- Do not create a duplicate job
- Do not create a duplicate deployment

Expected error:

WORKER_ACCESS_ALREADY_USED

Return:

- Replay timestamp
- HTTP status
- Error code
- Duplicate job count
- Duplicate deployment count

Expected:

Replay rejected: YES
Duplicate job: NO
Duplicate deployment: NO

==================================================
9. VERIFY PERSISTENCE AND RECOVERY
==================================================

Restart the worker safely.

Verify:

- Completed job remains completed
- Proof ledger remains available
- Token remains consumed
- Worker heartbeat returns
- No duplicate execution occurs
- Queue state remains consistent

==================================================
10. VERIFY ROLLBACK READINESS
==================================================

Return:

- Current stable SHA
- Previous stable SHA
- API rollback target
- Worker rollback target
- Database compatibility status
- Rollback action
- Recovery verification

Do not perform a destructive rollback unless necessary.

==================================================
11. REMOVE THE OLD OWNER SESSION DEPENDENCY
==================================================

After the live autonomous deployment passes:

- Stop requiring IVX_OWNER_TOKEN_SESSION for worker execution
- Mark it deprecated
- Remove it from required startup validation
- Confirm no production route still depends on it
- Do not delete it blindly before dependency verification

The permanent flow must be:

OWNER LOGIN
→ LIVE SUPABASE SESSION
→ OWNER APPROVAL
→ SHORT-LIVED SINGLE-USE WORKER ACCESS
→ HMAC WORKER
→ CI
→ BUILD
→ DEPLOY
→ VERIFY
→ PROOF LEDGER

==================================================
12. RETURN FINAL LIVE EVIDENCE
==================================================

OWNER AUTHORIZATION

- Owner session valid:
- Owner verified:
- Authorization ID:
- Action:
- Repository:
- Branch:
- Approved SHA:
- Worker ID:
- Issued at:
- Expires at:
- Hash-only storage:
- Consumed:

AUTONOMOUS JOB

- Job ID:
- Worker ID:
- Initial status:
- Final status:
- Started:
- Completed:
- Proof ledger ID:

GITHUB ACTIONS

- Workflow run ID:
- Commit SHA:
- Backend tests:
- Android release consistency:
- Security:
- Final result:

RENDER API

- Service ID:
- Deployment ID:
- Live SHA:
- Status:
- Boot time:

RENDER WORKER

- Service ID:
- Deployment ID:
- Live SHA:
- Status:
- Heartbeat:
- Last completed job:

WEBSITE

- Deployment ID:
- URL:
- HTTP status:
- Live version:

LIVE VERIFICATION

- /health:
- /version:
- Public chat:
- Unauthorized owner request:
- Valid owner request:
- Worker status:

SECURITY

- Replay rejected:
- Duplicate job:
- Duplicate deployment:
- Secret scan:
- Independence guard:

ROLLBACK

- Current stable SHA:
- Previous stable SHA:
- Rollback available:
- Recovery verified:

==================================================
FINAL PASS CONDITIONS
==================================================

Mark AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT = PASS only when:

- Owner authorizes from inside IVX
- Live Supabase owner session validates
- Short-lived single-use worker access is created
- Only the token hash is stored
- Worker consumes the authorization once
- GitHub Actions passes
- Exact approved SHA is deployed
- API and worker live SHAs match the approved SHA
- /health returns HTTP 200
- /version returns the approved SHA
- Public chat works
- Proof ledger is written
- Replay is rejected
- No duplicate deployment occurs
- Worker restart does not repeat the job
- Rollback path is available
- Rork is not required in the production deployment chain

FINAL STATUS

AUTONOMOUS DEPLOYMENT:
PASS / PARTIAL / FAIL

OWNER APPROVAL FLOW:
PASS / FAIL

CI:
PASS / FAIL

DEPLOYMENT:
PASS / FAIL

REPLAY PROTECTION:
PASS / FAIL

PROOF LEDGER:
PASS / FAIL

RORK REQUIRED FOR PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT:
YES / NO

Do not return another plan.
Execute the full chain and return only live evidence.
